title: CAMA Paper Figure Generation, LaTeX Assembly, and PDF Compilation
summary: Demo notebook that loads pre-extracted experiment data from 9 dependency experiments and generates 3 publication-quality figures: (1) forest plot of per-task Cohen's d effect sizes for CAMA vs mean aggregation, (2) information compression bar chart at FK joins, (3) gate value heatmap showing stasis patterns. Also computes evaluation metrics (pooled d=0.84, 8 tasks, 5 databases) and visualizes ablation study results comparing 6 aggregation methods on rel-f1/driver-position. Uses mini_demo_data.json with all Cohen's d, compression, gate analysis, and ablation data.
